requirements.desc: `collectTestFiles(root, specDir)` must include only `.test` or `.spec` JavaScript/TypeScript module files under `path.resolve(root, specDir, "tests")` and must not include project root `tests/`, `specs/<id>/tests/.raw/test-execution.log`, or `specs/<id>/spec.md` content.
requirements.note: R1: collects only spec-local test modules and excludes root tests, raw logs, and spec.md

requirements.desc: `buildGapAnalysisPrompt(testDesign, testFiles)` and `buildTestFixPrompt(testDesign, gaps, testFiles)` must include `testDesign` in `systemPrompt` under `## Test Design` and must not include `## Test Design` in `userPrompt`.
requirements.note: R2: keeps test design in systemPrompt for gap-analysis and gap-fix prompts

requirements.desc: review-test prompt size enforcement must use a 1,000,000 character limit and must stop before invoking the configured agent when the measured prompt exceeds that limit.
requirements.note: R3: exposes and enforces the 1,000,000 character provider-boundary limit

requirements.desc: The change must not alter review-test AI scoring, finding classification, auto-fix behavior, CLI options, or exit-code semantics.
requirements.note: R5: contract tests do not require review-test scoring, CLI, or exit-code changes

entries.reason: draft gate failed because qa[1].category used invalid value test strategy
entries.resolution: Change qa[1].category to an accepted draft QA category after scanning draft.json categories

entries.reason: draft gate failed because draft wording used vague phrases: large behavior changes, improved contract, and minimal verification
entries.resolution: Replace vague phrases throughout draft.json with verifiable scope and test conditions

entries.reason: spec gate failed because bounded-resource-usage needed explicit treatment for existing recursive collectTestsRecursive traversal
entries.resolution: Add bounded-resource-usage acknowledgment in spec constraints while preserving the Issue #369 scope and the 1,000,000 character provider-boundary limit

entries.reason: scenario-validity blocked because plan/test added shared tests under tests/unit before the scenario-validity phase
entries.resolution: Remove the shared unit test edits from the plan-phase test artifact and keep shared npm-test coverage for the implementation phase

entries.reason: spec-local test used missing named ESM exports, causing SyntaxError and invalid_test classifications instead of per-requirement expected failures
entries.resolution: Use namespace import and assertion-based contract-surface checks so tests execute and fail per requirement

entries.reason: test-review failed because R4 was incorrectly covered by a spec-local test and R1 lacked non-test files inside the spec-local tests directory
entries.resolution: Mark R4 as not spec-local-testable, remove R4 from the spec-local header/test, and add non-test module fixtures for R1

entries.reason: test-review failed because R1 lacked TypeScript fixture coverage and R3 only tested the prompt limit helper instead of the review-test execution boundary
entries.resolution: Add TypeScript test fixtures for R1 and require a dependency-injected review-test execution helper that proves over-limit prompts stop before agent invocation
